title: AWS DevOps Engineer
description:
About You

You are a proactive DevOps Engineer who enjoys building, automating, and maintaining reliable cloud infrastructure. You take ownership of environments end to end from access management and CI/CD pipelines to Kubernetes workloads and you thrive in fast-paced environments where stability, security, and scalability are critical. You’re looking for a role where you can grow your cloud expertise, influence infrastructure decisions, and collaborate closely with engineering teams.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or a related role.
  • Strong proficiency with AWS services, particularly IAM, RDS, and EKS.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
  • Solid background designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with microservices architectures and container orchestration concepts.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Python and/or Bash (desirable).
  • AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) are a plus.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, permissions, and access management.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with global and US-based teams.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Provision and manage AWS accounts, organizational permissions, IAM roles, and cost monitoring.
  • Manage and support both employee and organizational infrastructure to ensure smooth and secure operations.
  • Handle workstation setups, configurations, and deprovisioning during employee onboarding and offboarding.
  • Implement, manage, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform for consistent and repeatable deployments.
  • Oversee AWS IAM roles and permissions for users, services, and applications.
  • Maintain and optimize microservices infrastructure on AWS EKS.
  • Design, develop, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support secure, reliable, and efficient deployments.
  • Collaborate with development teams to improve infrastructure reliability, scalability, and automation.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to enhance operational efficiency, security, and cost optimization.

Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

title: Analista de contabilidade sênior
description:
Sobre a Posição:

Buscamos um(a) Analista Contábil Sênior para atuar de forma estratégica na área de Controladoria , com forte interface com operações e áreas de negócio. Esta posição é responsável por garantir a integridade das informações contábeis relacionadas a estoques e ativos fixos , apoiando o fechamento mensal e assegurando conformidade com normas contábeis, políticas internas e controles corporativos.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Garantir a acuracidade contábil dos estoques por meio de análises, conciliações, fechamento e reporte das contas.
  • Analisar e acompanhar contas transitórias de ativo fixo, assegurando correta classificação, capitalização e aderência às políticas contábeis.
  • Atuar no processo de capitalização de ativos fixos, incluindo controle e acompanhamento de autorizações de investimento.
  • Planejar, executar e acompanhar inventários físicos de estoques e ativos fixos, garantindo alinhamento entre registros físicos e contábeis.
  • Apoiar a análise de gastos, avaliando a correta classificação entre despesas e ativo imobilizado.
  • Analisar, reportar e discutir variações de inventário junto à liderança da área, contribuindo com análises críticas e recomendações.
  • Atuar em parceria com unidades operacionais e áreas de negócio, apoiando trâmites internos, controles e processos fiscais.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos procedimentos de Controladoria, controles internos e boas práticas contábeis, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos processos.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Formação superior completa em Ciências Contábeis , com CRC ativo
  • Sólida experiência em contabilidade geral e contabilidade aplicada a operações
  • Vivência consistente com estoques, inventários, ativos fixos e fechamento contábil mensal
  • Conhecimento de ambientes operacionais e processos produtivos
  • Excel em nível intermediário a avançado

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em ambientes operacionais ou industriais de maior complexidade
  • Vivência em empresas de grande porte ou multinacionais
  • Perfil analítico, crítico, organizado e orientado a processos e controles

title: Assistente de Implantação
description:
A Convergint é uma empresa global, fundada em 2001 nos arredores de Chicago, que atua como integradora de sistemas especializada em segurança eletrônica, automação predial, áudio e vídeo, sistemas de incêndio e life safety, com objetivo de ser o melhor provedor de serviços para os nossos clientes.

Atualmente, contamos com mais de 11 mil colaboradores e estamos presentes em mais de 225 escritórios ao redor do mundo.

Descritivo:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Assistente de Implantação, responsável pela execução de atividades de infraestrutura e instalação de equipamentos eletrônicos, garantindo a qualidade, segurança e conformidade com os padrões internos da empresa.

Principais Atividades:

  • Passagem de cabos de dados e elétricos em tubulações, canaletas e caixas de passagem para interligação de equipamentos, painéis e dispositivos eletrônicos realizando trabalhos em altura (NR35)
  • Fixação de dispositivos e equipamentos (cameras, sensores, dispositivos eletrônicos, sonofletores, vídeo monitores, etc)
  • Disponibilidade de viagem para atender projetos em outros estados, seguindo a política de viagens estabelecido pela empresa.
  • Conhecer, entender e seguir as políticas e procedimentos do Sistema de Gestão da Convergint com foco em qualidade, Segurança da Informação Privacidade e Compliance / Antissuborno.
  • Propor melhorias para os processos e serviços visando manter e melhorar continuamente a Qualidade dos serviços, Segurança da Informação e Privacidade e Compliance / Antissuborno, incluindo participação na identificação e determinação de ações para minimização e controle dos riscos relacionados.
  • Encaminhar para os responsáveis qualquer evento ou incidente de Segurança da Informação ou Privacidade.

Conhecimentos:

  • Manuseio de ferramentas elétricas (parafusadeira, furadeira, esmerilhadeira)
  • Conectorização de cabos (RJ45, Keystone, P2, P10, DB9, Terminais elétricos)

title: Representante Comercial On Trade - Ribeirão Preto (São Paulo)
description:
Sobre Nós (A Cultura Zahil)

Somos uma referência consolidada de 39 anos no mercado brasileiro na importação e distribuição de vinhos. Nosso portfólio possui mais de 400 rótulos de 70 produtores de 15 países, presentes em mais de 4.000 pontos de venda em todo o país. Acreditamos que o vinho é capaz de conectar pessoas e criar momentos únicos.

O Perfil que Buscamos:

Você é um profissional naturalmente curioso e orientado a resultados , que enxerga cada negócio como uma oportunidade de construir uma parceria duradoura. Buscamos alguém com maturidade para trabalhar com total autonomia , gerindo sua carteira de clientes com a criatividade necessária para inovar dentro de um ambiente que valoriza tanto a tradição quanto a evolução.

Características que nos inspiram:

  • Mentalidade analítica: Usa dados para fundamentar decisões e montar cartas de vinho estratégicas para o canal gastronômico.
  • Visão estratégica: Enxerga o panorama completo (cliente, mercado local, concorrência) antes de agir.
  • Adaptabilidade: Aprende rapidamente e se reinventa conforme as necessidades dos restaurantes e hotéis da região.
  • Proatividade: Antecipa necessidades do estabelecimento e propõe soluções de portfólio e serviço.
  • Resiliência: Transforma os desafios da negociação e do dia a dia em oportunidades de crescimento.

Descrição da Oportunidade:

O(A) Representante Comercial será o elo estratégico da Zahil com o segmento On-Trade em Ribeirão Preto. O foco total é construir e gerenciar relacionamentos com os principais restaurantes, hotéis, bares e casas de eventos da região.

A função exige uma prospecção ativa e uma gestão de carteira inteligente, transformando o portfólio Zahil em cartas de vinhos vencedoras e rentáveis para nossos parceiros. Buscamos alguém com agilidade para navegar no dinâmico mercado gastronômico local, atuando como um consultor para donos de restaurantes, sommeliers e gerentes de A&B.

Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar a carteira On-Trade (restaurantes, hotéis, bares) em Ribeirão Preto, fortalecendo o relacionamento e identificando novas oportunidades.
  • Prospectar ativamente novos estabelecimentos com perfil estratégico para o portfólio Zahil.
  • Análise Consultiva de Cartas: Analisar as cartas de vinho atuais e apresentar rótulos que façam a diferença, considerando harmonização, precificação e perfil do público local.
  • Negociação e Visibilidade: Negociar a inclusão de novos rótulos e ações de visibilidade (ex: vinho em taça, "wine dinners").
  • Treinamento de Brigada: Organizar e executar treinamentos para as equipes de salão e sommeliers, focando no conhecimento do produto e em técnicas para impulsionar o giro no salão.
  • Inteligência de Mercado: Reportar à gerência as demandas do trade local e ações da concorrência.
  • Gestão Digital: Apoiar no uso de sistemas de CRM para gestão do funil e colocação de pedidos.

Qualificações e Experiência:

  • Escolaridade: Desejável graduação completa.
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Curso de vinhos (WSET, ABS, etc.) é fundamental para o diálogo com sommeliers.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 3 anos em vendas B2B, com experiência comprovada no canal On-Trade .
  • Regionalismo: Residência em Ribeirão Preto e profundo conhecimento da malha gastronômica da cidade.
  • Networking: Relacionamento ativo e carteira pré-existente com donos de restaurantes e gerentes de A&B na região será um grande diferencial.
  • Requisitos Legais: Empresa de representação ativa (CNPJ).

Remuneração e Modelo de Contratação:

  • Regime: PJ (Contrato de Representação Comercial).
  • Remuneração: 5% de comissão de todas as vendas efetuadas.

title: Analista de Dados (Temporário)
description:
O candidato ideal vai garantir a qualidade dos fornecedores por meio da análise avançada de dados, automação de processos e suporte à tomada de decisão estratégica, reduzindo riscos e aumentando a eficiência da cadeia de suprimentos.

Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Dados de Qualidade: Coletar, organizar e analisar indicadores de desempenho dos fornecedores. Criar dashboards e relatórios inteligentes para acompanhamento em tempo real.
  • Automação e Inteligência de Processos: Desenvolver scripts, macros ou ferramentas de automação para reduzir tarefas repetitivas. Implementar soluções de RPA (Robotic Process Automation) ou BI para otimizar fluxos de trabalho.
  • Análise Técnica e Preventiva: Realizar análises estatísticas para identificar causas raiz. Propor planos de ação e melhorias baseadas em dados, não apenas em observações operacionais.
  • Gestão de Fornecedores: Avaliar e monitorar fornecedores com base em KPIs técnicos. Apoiar processos de homologação e reavaliação de fornecedores com critérios objetivos e digitais.

Experiência e Competências

  • Graduação em Engenharia (Produção, Mecânica, Elétrica, Computação) ou áreas correlatas.
  • Ferramentas de BI e Data Analytics: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, Excel avançado (Power Query, VBA).
  • Linguagens de Programação: Python ou R para análise de dados e automação.
  • Comunicação clara para traduzir análises técnicas em decisões de negócio.

title: Coordenador(a) Manutenção Logística
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Desafio:

Planejar, coordenar e controlar as atividades de manutenção da frota e dos ativos logísticos, assegurando alta disponibilidade operacional, segurança, confiabilidade e otimização de custos, em alinhamento com as metas da gerência, produção e nível de serviço da Arauco.

Principais Atividades:

  • Assegurar a execução do plano de manutenção das frotas sob sua responsabilidade, monitorando os pontos críticos do fluxo e antecipando riscos, com intervenções rápidas para evitar rupturas e impactos na produção.
  • Liderar e auditar o desempenho das equipes próprias e terceiras parceiras, monitorando disponibilidade de frota, produtividade, segurança e custo.
  • Gerir os custos da área, realizando a previsão orçamentária anual e o acompanhamento mensal do realizado, por meio de aprovações de gastos, análises críticas e ações de otimização para garantir aderência ao orçamento.
  • Acompanhar e analisar os indicadores de gestão (KPIs) das empresas prestadoras de serviço, garantindo a aderência contratual e a sustentabilidade econômico-financeira dos contratos sob sua gestão.

title: Network Technician
description:
Job Description: Network Technician

Locations : Guarulhos, Brazil

Contract: Long Term

About Teceze

Teceze is a global IT services and consulting company providing reliable end-user computing, infrastructure support, and managed IT services to enterprise clients. We deliver high-quality on-site and remote support, ensuring seamless IT operations for our customers.

Job Overview

Teceze is hiring a Network Technician – Level 1 to support one of our enterprise clients. The ideal candidate will provide first-level network and infrastructure support, assist with installations, troubleshooting, and monitoring, and ensure stable network operations at the client site.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 1 support for network-related issues including LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, and basic routing/switching problems
  • Assist in installation, configuration, and maintenance of network devices such as switches, routers, access points, and firewalls
  • Perform basic network troubleshooting and escalate complex issues to Level 2/3 teams
  • Monitor network performance and report incidents, outages, and security concerns
  • Support cable management, patching, and rack-and-stack activities in data centers and IDF/MDF rooms
  • Maintain accurate documentation of network topology, configurations, and incident logs
  • Assist with user connectivity issues including VPN, wireless access, and port activation
  • Follow client and Teceze IT standards, policies, and change management procedures
  • Coordinate with onsite and remote teams to ensure timely resolution of issues

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Diploma / Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • 0–2 years of experience in network or IT infrastructure support
  • Basic knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and subnetting
  • Familiarity with networking hardware (Cisco, HP, Aruba, or similar)
  • Understanding of wired and wireless network concepts
  • Ability to troubleshoot connectivity and performance issues
  • Good communication and documentation skills
  • Willingness to work onsite and provide shift or on-call support if required

Preferred Qualifications

  • CCNA or equivalent networking certification (or in progress)
  • Experience in enterprise or client-facing environments
  • Basic knowledge of network security concepts

title: Especialista em Inteligência e Performance de Frotas
description:
A Aegea, criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

  • Monitorar indicadores como autonomia, disponibilidade, padrões de uso e eficiência operacional.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com a área operacional, fornecendo direcionamentos técnicos e analíticos.
  • Buscar e avaliar novas tecnologias e soluções de mercado para gestão de frotas, propondo e apoiando implantações.
  • Produzir relatórios periódicos (diários, semanais e mensais) para compartilhamento com liderança e unidades.
  • Apoiar análises contratuais sob a ótica de dados e performance.

  • Forte domínio de BI, análise de dados e indicadores .
  • Experiência com grandes bases de dados operacionais.
  • Conhecimento em telemetria e indicadores de performance de veículos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar dados complexos e traduzi-los em insights acionáveis.

Com mais de 11 bilhões de transações processadas anualmente, somos referência em soluções que impulsionam a transformação digital do mercado.

Oferecemos um portfólio completo de soluções em software , atendendo instituições financeiras, empresas e fintechs que buscam inovação, segurança e eficiência .

Nosso compromisso é com a excelência tecnológica , a inclusão financeira e a geração de valor sustentável para clientes, colaboradores e parceiros, promovendo um ecossistema mais conectado e acessível.

A área de Remuneração é responsável por implementar e manter políticas e práticas salariais que garantam competitividade, equidade interna e alinhamento com a estratégia da empresa , e busca um Analista de Remuneração e Benefícios SR para compor nosso time, na maior empresa de desenvolvimento de softwares e produtos para o mercado financeiro do Brasil, onde acreditamos que a inovação tecnológica inspira a evolução

Esse cargo será responsável por:

  • Desenhar, manter e governar a arquitetura de cargos (Levels, trilhas de carreira), garantindo equidade interna e competitividade externa.
  • Liderar o ciclo anual de revisão salarial, definindo diretrizes, elegibilidade, budgets, regras de exceção e prazos
  • Orquestrar o Ciclo Anual de Remuneração: planejamento, comunicação, calibragens, aprovações, execução e pós-mortem.
  • Monitorar tendências de mercado (benefícios emergentes, incentivos, premiações) e sugerir inovações alinhadas ao perfil da empresa.
  • Contribuir para PPR (regras, metas corporativas, comunicação, cálculo, auditoria) e incentivos de curto e longo prazo (STI/LTI).
  • Garantir aderência à legislação trabalhista, políticas internas e auditorias (internas/externas), mantendo trilhas de evidência.
  • Realizar análises preditivas (risco de evasão por gap de mercado, elasticidade de retenção, impactos de ajustes) e apresentar insights acionáveis.
  • Atuar como especialista consultivo, orientando líderes e Business Partners em propostas de contratação, movimentações internas e retenções.
  • Mapear e otimizar processos críticos (ciclos, aprovações, integrações com folha, reporting), com foco em agilidade e auditabilidade.
  • Apoiar gestão de mudança em alterações de políticas, revisões de faixas, atualizações de programas de incentivo.
  • Elaborar materiais de comunicação para líderes e colaboradores (guides, FAQs, políticas, comunicados), com linguagem clara e objetiva.

Para dar #match, essa vaga necessita que atenda alguns requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas;
  • Excel intermediário a avançado;
  • Ter atuando diretamente com Remuneração / Cargos & Salários / C&B / People Analytics de Remuneração em empresa média/grande ou consultoria;
  • Entendimento de CCTs (Convenções Coletivas) e impacto em cargos/faixas/benefícios quando aplicável;
  • Capacidade de traduzir dados em recomendações práticas, influenciando decisões de negócio com base em evidências.

Caso possua o conhecimento ou atuação abaixo, será um diferencial:

  • Inglês e/ou Espanhol intermediário a avançado;

  • Conhecimento em BI.

IMPORTANTE : Essa oportunidade é para atuação no escritório da Evertec em SP (modalidade híbrido).

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.

We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development

Quality : At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving : We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: DevOps Engineer - Sr. Associate
description:
About the Company

Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.

Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.

Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

Cloud Infrastructure & Orchestration

  • Architect and manage container platforms (AWS ECS or EKS) ensuring scalability, high availability, and fault tolerance critical for financial transactions.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or CloudFormation to standardize environments and ensure reproducibility across development, staging, and production.
  • Manage AWS Networking components (VPCs, Subnets, Transit Gateways, Route 53, Load Balancers) with a focus on network segregation and security best practices.

CI/CD & Automation

  • Design and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines to support agile software delivery while enforcing strict quality gates and security checks.
  • Automate operational tasks using Python or Bash to reduce manual intervention and operational risk.
  • Drive the "Shift-Left" approach, integrating testing and security scanning early in the development lifecycle.

Observability, Reliability & Performance

  • Configure and maintain comprehensive observability solutions (APM, dashboards, distributed tracing, and centralized logging) to ensure real-time visibility into system health.
  • Proactively monitor application performance and infrastructure metrics to prevent incidents and optimize resource utilization.
  • Define and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Error Budgets to maintain the reliability required for a 24/7 financial operation.

Security, Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure secure container lifecycles, managing ECR (Image Registry) with strict vulnerability scanning and patching routines for third-party and internal images.
  • Implement security controls and access management (IAM) aligned with financial regulatory standards (e.g., BACEN, LGPD) and audit requirements.
  • Collaborate with the Security team to implement immutable infrastructure and ensure audit trails for all infrastructure changes.

Requirements

  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese and Professional English (technical reading and writing are essential).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Engineering roles.
  • Solid knowledge of Python and proficiency in Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation.
  • Deep proficiency in Docker, container orchestration (ECS or EKS), and Helm.
  • Experience with AWS networking architecture and security groups.
  • Practical experience with APM tools (e.g., Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace) and logging stacks (ELK, Splunk, CloudWatch).

Differentiators (Nice to have)

  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional or Solutions Architect Professional.
  • CKA/CKAD (Kubernetes) Certification.
  • Prior experience in the Financial Sector (FinTechs, Banks, Payments), specifically dealing with regulatory requirements and critical mission environments.
  • Experience with GitOps workflows (e.g., ArgoCD).

● Desenvolver aplicações e serviços backend em Java (usando Spring Boot) focados no processamento e integração de dados, incluindo a construção de APIs RESTful ou microserviços que permitam o consumo e fornecimento de dados via base dimensional.

● Implementar pipelines de dados e fluxos de processamento em Java, integrando com sistemas de mensageria (ex: Apache Kafka) e outros mecanismos de streaming quando necessário, para capturar dados transacionais em tempo real e persistí-los de forma segura.

● Projetar e otimizar esquemas de banco de dados PostgreSQL para armazenar dados = provenientes de sistemas legados ou da camada de ingestão, garantindo normalização adequada ou modelagem relacional conforme necessário, além de criar índices e otimizar consultas para alto desempenho.

description:
Job Title: Java Developer – Camunda 8

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Work Model: Hybrid (2 days onsite per week + remaining days remote)

Project Duration: Long Term Contract

Role Summary

We are seeking a skilled Java Developer with hands-on experience in Camunda 8 and Spring Boot to design, develop, and maintain BPMN-based workflow solutions and microservices architectures. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Java development, agile methodologies, automated testing, and CI/CD practices.   • Collaborate with business stakeholders to refine requirements and deliver optimal solutions.
  • Take ownership of deliverables, ensuring alignment with scope, quality, and timelines.
  • Contribute to system architecture and technical design documentation.

Technical Requirements

  • Hands-on experience in designing and implementing BPMN workflows using Camunda 8 .
  • Strong expertise in Java 11+ with solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming principles.
  • Extensive experience with Spring Framework and Spring Boot .
  • Experience working with:
  • Spring Cloud Config
  • Spring Data JPA
  • Spring MVC
  • Strong knowledge of microservices and service-oriented architecture (SOA).
  • Experience with automated testing tools such as JUnit, Mockito, and Cucumber .
  • Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines and tools.
  • Familiarity with RESTful API design and integration.
  • Experience working in Agile/SCRUM environments.
  • English proficiency level: B2 or higher.

Soft Skills

  • Strong collaboration and teamwork abilities.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and results-driven mindset.
  • Adaptability to dynamic and fast-paced environments.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong time management and productivity skills.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Pragmatic and solution-oriented approach.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Hands-on experience configuring CI/CD tools.
  • Familiarity with ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) or other NoSQL databases.
  • Basic knowledge of Spanish.

title: Account Executive - Marketing Solutions
description:
São Paulo/SP - Brazil

SiiLA is the dominant authority in commercial real estate news, data, and analysis across Latin America. Since our founding in 2015, we have built a reputation for delivering precise , reliable market intelligence with a relentless commitment to quality and integrity .

Powered by cutting-edge technology, SiiLA transforms raw data into actionable insights through subscription-based solutions trusted by the world’s top commercial real estate professionals. Our platform offers unparalleled transparency , empowering clients to make informed decisions in a rapidly evolving industry.

Visit our website: siila.com.br

About the Role:

Are you passionate about commercial real estate, technology, and helping others succeed? SiiLA is looking for an Account Executive who combines business acumen with a consultative approach to selling.

This is not just a sales role—it’s an opportunity to join a dynamic, fast-growing organization where your efforts will directly influence our continued success. We’re looking for someone who is eager to become an expert in our products, understands the nuances of the commercial real estate industry, and embraces the challenge of developing long-term client relationships.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop a deep understanding of SiiLA’s products, data, and the commercial real estate market to build credibility and be a trusted advisor to clients.
  • Understand the Platform's Advertising Features: Gain a deep knowledge of the platform’s advertising offerings, tools, and capabilities to effectively showcase the benefits to potential clients and maximize their value.
  • Strategize Advertising Solutions: Work closely with the marketing team to design customized advertising solutions for clients, utilizing platform features to target the right audience and enhance commercial real estate market visibility.
  • Client Consultation & Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor by understanding clients’ needs and leveraging the platform’s advertising tools to achieve their business objectives, particularly in the commercial real estate sector.
  • Actively identify and qualify new business opportunities, leveraging a consultative selling approach to tailor solutions to client needs.
  • Engage with prospects through persistent outreach, effective listening, and thoughtful presentations to communicate SiiLA’s value proposition.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Continuously monitor the performance of advertising campaigns on the platform, providing clients with insights and recommendations to optimize their campaigns.
  • Educate Clients on the Platform’s Value: Conduct presentations, training sessions, and workshops to educate clients on effectively using the platform’s advertising features, fostering long-term client relationships and engagement.
  • Collaborate with Product Development: Provide feedback to the product development team regarding client needs and industry trends, helping to refine and enhance the platform’s advertising benefits for greater market relevance.
  • Drive Client Acquisition & Retention: Proactively identify opportunities to acquire new clients and retain existing ones by showcasing the unique advantages and results that the platform’s advertising solutions deliver within the commercial real estate market.
  • Stay Current with Industry Trends: Keep updated with digital advertising and commercial real estate trends to ensure the platform remains competitive and aligned with market demands.
  • Take initiative to experiment, refine processes, and share ideas to help SiiLA scale in the Brazil Market and beyond.
  • Build strong relationships with prospects, clients, and industry stakeholders, maintaining trust and delivering value .
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and exceptional client experiences .

What Makes You a Great Fit:

· Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.

· A minimum of three years of experience in Marketing sales, preferably within commercial real estate, technology, or a related industry.

· Strong business sense with the ability to qualify prospects effectively and identify opportunities for tailored solutions in Marketing.

· A natural curiosity and willingness to dive into data, technology, and market trends to build expertise and credibility.

· Entrepreneurial mindset with a drive to contribute to the growth of a fast-evolving organization and make a measurable impact.

· Excellent interpersonal skills and clear, effective communication in both English and Portuguese.

· Persistence and resilience in handling objections, with the ability to bounce back and stay motivated .

· Strong organizational skills to manage multiple priorities, stay on top of leads, and deliver results .

· Confidence and presence to engage with executives while remaining personable and approachable.

· Coachable and adaptable , with a continuous improvement mindset and the ability to apply feedback effectively.

Follow us: @siila.br

  • Ensure compliance with schema validation and maintain configuration hygiene.

Mandatory Knowledge

  • YAML/JSON (production-grade): Safe authoring/refactoring, strict structure, and change hygiene.
  • Git + PR workflow: Clean diffs, review discipline, conflict handling, and controlled promotions.
  • Observability & log analysis: Tracing failures across pipeline stages, correlating identifiers, and extracting actionable signals from logs/metrics.
  • Schema/validation mindset: Interpreting schema/tooling errors and keeping configs compliant.
  • Python: Debugging and adjusting existing scripts/automation; implementing targeted fixes safely.
  • Databases (SQL): Querying to investigate production issues, validate data integrity, and confirm outcomes.
  • Production support fundamentals: Incident triage, root-cause analysis, mitigations, and regression verification.
  • Jinja templating: Understanding template-driven generation and making safe, minimal changes.

Optional Knowledge

  • Media Supply Chain fundamentals: Deliverables, packaging concepts, metadata hierarchies, locale conventions, and downstream dependency impacts.
  • Advanced mapping/config patterns (conditional/switch/lookup/padding; robust globals/locals usage).
  • CI/automation improvements (linting/formatting, pre-validation checks, regression harnesses).
  • Partner operations context (common rejection patterns, partner-specific exceptions, operational playbooks).
  • Communication in incident/PR contexts (concise updates, change summaries, and requirement translation).

Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience in production support for large-scale delivery platforms.
  • Strong understanding of schema-driven configuration management and automation workflows.

title: Representantes de Negócio
description:
Grow Up by MetLife | Representantes de Negócio

Sobre a iniciativa

Sua empresa poderá fazer parte de uma iniciativa estratégica da MetLife voltada ao desenvolvimento de Representantes de Negócio, com foco em expansão comercial e construção de operações sustentáveis.

O Grow Up by MetLife foi concebido para empresas com expertise empresarial que atuam com protagonismo estratégico, alinhando a operação própria ao modelo de negócios da companhia.

A oportunidade

O Grow Up by MetLife é um programa de aceleração executiva, estruturado para transferir know-how para futuros parceiros comerciais na modalidade de Representantes MetLife.

  • Etapa 1 – Base de Negócios (6 meses): imersão prática no negócio, desenvolvimento comercial, conhecimento técnico de produtos e relacionamento com clientes.
  • Etapa 2 – Consolidação (18 meses): ampliação de atuação, construção de carteira, visão de gestão e apoio à expansão comercial.
  • Etapa 3 – Escalada: consolidação como líder de negócio, com autonomia, estrutura própria e capacidade de multiplicar resultados.

A jornada contempla etapas progressivas de desenvolvimento em gestão comercial, governança e expansão territorial, com foco em resultados de longo prazo. Em decorrência da progressão, o parceiro terá o know-how relacionado ao desenvolvimento de mercado e consolidação de resultados, culminando na condução de uma operação própria, com autonomia estratégica.

Principais objetos do modelo de parceria

- Conduzir a estratégia de expansão comercial do seu negócio em parceria com a MetLife na região de atuação da sua empresa, a partir de análises de mercado e planejamento estratégico.

- Estruturar, assessorar e dar suporte a Parceiros Comerciais, assegurando produtividade e qualidade.

- Gerir e expandir a carteira de negócios de sua empresa com foco em crescimento sustentável, rentabilidade e recorrência.

- Atuar de forma consultiva junto a clientes e parceiros estratégicos, fortalecendo relacionamentos.

- Assegurar excelência técnica e conformidade com as diretrizes legais e administrativas.

Requisitos para atuação no programa

- Atuação empresarial consolidada em atividades comerciais, preferencialmente consultivas, complexas e de alta responsabilidade.

- Experiência da empresa em projetos de expansão ou desenvolvimento de operações comerciais.

- Capacidade analítica, visão estratégica e domínio técnico para tomada de decisões no nível empresarial.

- Presença e penetração de mercado, com influência e capacidade de negociação em diferentes níveis.

- Perfil empresarial empreendedor, com compromisso com resultados e construção sustentável no longo prazo.

Diferenciais

- Histórico consistente da empresa na formação, desenvolvimento e gestão de times comerciais.

- Atuação prévia da empresa como representante ou responsável por unidades de negócio.

- Capacidade da empresa de estruturar processos comerciais e indicadores de performance.

Por que o Grow Up by MetLife

O Grow Up by MetLife é destinado a empresas que buscam solidez, independência estratégica e geração de valor, contando com o respaldo institucional de uma multinacional e a liberdade de empreender.

● Desenvolver e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para automação de deploy das aplicações e componentes de dados (serviços Java, notebooks Databricks, configurações de bancos), promovendo entregas constantes e confiáveis sem interrupção do serviço.

● Implementar soluções de monitoramento, logging e alerta para todos os componentes da plataforma (uso de ferramentas como Prometheus/Grafana, ELK Stack ou equivalentes), garantindo observabilidade completa do sistema (métricas de performance, falhas, latências, utilização de recursos) e resposta rápida a incidentes.

● Trabalhar junto aos engenheiros de dados e desenvolvedores para melhorar a confiabilidade das aplicações, revisando configurações, identificando pontos únicos de falha e implementando soluções de resiliência (como balanceamento de carga, retries automáticos, fallback).

● Gerenciar a segurança e conformidade da infraestrutura, aplicando atualizações de sistema, patches de segurança, configurações de firewall e acessos apropriados, em alinhamento com políticas corporativas e requisitos (por exemplo, LGPD).

● Otimizar a performance e custo da infraestrutura, monitorando uso de recursos e escalando ambientes conforme necessidade (vertical ou horizontalmente), bem como implementando rotinas de housekeeping (expurgo de logs, archiving de dados) para manter o ambiente saudável.

● Liderar a resposta a incidentes críticos relacionados à infraestrutura ou disponibilidade dos sistemas de dados, investigando raiz de problemas (post- mortem) e implementando ações preventivas para evitar recorrências.

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

● Domínio de sistemas operacionais Linux e competências em automação de infraestrutura (shell scripting, Python) e infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation ou similares).

● Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas de containerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes) para gerir serviços containerizados e escalar aplicações.

● Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) ou com ambientes virtualizados on-premises, compreendendo rede, armazenamento e computação, e habilidade para configurar serviços como bancos de dados gerenciados, balanceadores de carga, etc.

● Prática em configurar e manter ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch, etc.) e interpretar métricas para troubleshooting.

● Familiaridade com conceitos de SRE, incluindo definição de SLOs/SLAs, error budget, e experiência em protocolos de resposta a incidentes.

VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

  • Experiência no mercado financeiro

O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Business Analyst - Workday
description:

We are seeking a Senior Workday Business Analyst with strong expertise in Workday Business Processes (BPs) and functional integration knowledge . This is a strategic, functional role — not a technical development position — acting as a bridge between HR business teams, IT development, and QA.

The successful candidate will play a central role in translating business needs into clear process and integration requirements, ensuring alignment between Workday Business Processes and downstream integrations, and coordinating testing cycles to deliver high-quality solutions in a global Workday environment.

Write and maintain Business and System Requirements for new integrations and process enhancements.

Act as liaison between business stakeholders, developers, and QA teams .

Translate business requirements into functional specifications aligned with Workday configuration and integration frameworks.

Review current business processes, identify improvement opportunities, and recommend best practices.

Coordinate and support test planning, execution, and user acceptance testing (UAT) .

Perform functional validation of integrations, execute basic tests, and identify and report defects.

Refine requirements based on technical feedback and test outcomes.

Support project planning activities including estimates, schedules, and documentation in partnership with IT and project managers.

Deep understanding of how Workday Business Processes operate end-to-end.

Strong awareness that integration logic is driven by BP design .

Priority Business Processes include:

o Hire

o Termination

o Job Change

o Benefits & Life Events

Full mastery of all Workday BPs is not required — strong knowledge of approximately 25–50 core BPs is sufficient.

Ability to apply BP frameworks consistently across different functional areas.

Integrations (Functional Level):

Understand Workday’s integration framework and architecture .

Ability to open, review, and validate integrations against business requirements.

Execute basic functional integration testing.

Identify simple errors and communicate issues effectively to technical teams.

Write Business Requirements for new integrations .

No development or coding of integrations is expected.

Testing & Quality Assurance:

Partner closely with SDM and QA teams.

Contribute to test strategy, test plans, and test scripts .

Coordinate test cycles and track results through resolution.

Adjust requirements based on validation outcomes.

Support production deployment and post-go-live stabilization.

80% interaction with Senior HR Managers across functional workstreams (Benefits, HR Operations, etc.).

This role is not heavily political; strong process mastery enables confident stakeholder engagement.

Direct leadership support is available for executive-level presentations when needed.

Produce Business Requirements for new integrations.

Act as the central connector between business users, developers, and QA.

Refine requirements based on technical feedback.

Coordinate and oversee testing cycles.

Tools & Technical Environment:

Workday (required)

Flexibility to learn additional tools on the job.

Strong experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, and process documentation .

Solid understanding of SDLC methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to interpret data, identify issues, and recommend solutions.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities.

Ability to act as a key liaison between business operations and IT teams.

Experience working with senior-level business and technology stakeholders.

Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business, or related field — or equivalent experience.

5+ years of Workday HCM experience , preferably across Core HR, Benefits, Compensation, Recruiting, Payroll, or Talent modules.

Global Workday implementation experience preferred.

Experience in enterprise-scale or financial services environments is a plus.

We offer autonomy, clear goals and a dynamic and challenging environment, where professionals have the opportunity to interact with different technologies, participate in all types of projects, bring new ideas and work from anywhere in Brazil and (why not?) anywhere in the world. In addition, we are one of the best companies to work for in Brazil according to Great Place to Work and one of the 10 fastest growing technology companies in the country for 3 consecutive years, according to Anuário Informático Hoje.

- We have innovation and creativity in our DNA

All people are welcome regardless of their condition, disability, ethnicity, religious belief, sexual orientation, appearance, age or others. We want you to grow up with us in a welcoming environment full of opportunities.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.

You Are

An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.

Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.

Responsibilities
  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design
  • Contribute to UX/UI design for SaaS and internal software products
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
  • Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction
Qualifications
  • Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
  • Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  • Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

title: Senior Professional Services Engineer
description:
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.

This role focuses on post-sales deployment and optimization of Gigamon’s network visibility solutions, ensuring positive business outcomes for customers. The Professional Services Engineer will join a collaborative, innovative team with a strong emphasis on customer satisfaction, system optimization, and quality delivery. This is an individual contributor role that works closely with cross-functional teams, system architects, and end-user technical teams. The environment values technical expertise, problem-solving, and security-driven thinking. This is a hybrid role based in São Paulo (extended area), Brazil, and will occasionally require on-site support at customer locations.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead solution design, deployment, and optimization efforts for Gigamon’s network visibility and security products.
  • Work in a hybrid model based in São Paulo, Brazil, providing occasional on-site deployment, troubleshooting, and optimization support at customer locations as needed.
  • Identify deployment alternatives and propose optimized solutions for customers across various industries, including mobile networks, service providers, and enterprises.
  • Conduct testing, documentation, and pilot deliveries to ensure high-quality deployment results.
  • Work with Gigamon and customer network visibility and security teams on policy compliance efforts in line with Gigamon standards, industry privacy and security regulations, and guidelines set forth by applicable country, federal, and local laws.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage existing and prospective network visibility solutions, reviewing relevant use cases, security policies, and procedures with business stakeholders.
  • Partner closely with system architects to ensure business systems and applications meet security requirements in preparation for end‑user review, actively participating and contributing to internal Gigamon reviews.
  • Collaborate with Gigamon and end‑user technical teams to ensure developed tools, systems, and applications meet appropriate security standards, policies, and procedures.

What you’ve done:

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in the operational design and deployment of network management tools and applications in large-scale and/or virtualized networks, supporting mobile networks, service provider, enterprise, or government use cases.
  • Strong technical expertise in network protocols (TCP/IP, L2/L3, IPv4, IPv6), virtualization (VMware, Hyper‑V), and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, OpenStack).
  • Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) are highly desirable.
  • Proficiency in programming languages (Python, Java, C) and working with APIs is a plus.
  • Proven experience leading technical initiatives without formal authority and collaborating with virtual teams across different geographies.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and cybersecurity standards (ISO 27001/27002, CIS, NIST) is highly desirable.

Who you are:

  • Fully bilingual professional (English and Portuguese) able to hold professional conversations smoothly
  • A proactive problem-solver who thrives under pressure and can effectively communicate complex technical concepts.
  • A team player with excellent interpersonal skills who can work cross-functionally and lead without formal authority.
  • Highly analytical with a deep understanding of network security principles and compliance standards.
  • Detail-oriented, with a passion for continuous learning and staying updated on emerging technologies.

vPC, Multichassis EtherChannel);

Syslog protocol;

*Skilled in packet analysis using tools like Wireshark; Familiar with SNMP, DNS, DHCP,

SMTP;

*Comfortable working in Linux environments;

title: School Coordinator (K-12 Schools) (B2B)
description:
Partner Success Coordinator (K-12 Schools) (Customer Success, B2B)

******IMPORTANT******

Qualification: Mid (4yrs+) in academic coordination/operations, program management, or Customer Success

English: Fluent

Contract: PJ

Compensation: Salary + Bonus, depending on experience

Location: Hybrid, 3+ days on-site in Sao Paulo (Zona Sul); availability for nationwide travel (evenings/weekends as needed).

**********************

About Us

WorldEd is an established K–12 school with an international footprint built through long-term partnerships with schools and educational institutions. We support partners with high-quality academic programs, clear processes, and a delivery model designed for real implementation. As we grow, we’re tightening operations with people who execute reliably, ensuring strong partner experience and on-time student outcomes.

Job Overview

You'll own the day-to-day success of WorldEd's partner schools, ensuring programs run smoothly, academic processes execute on time, and students progress without delays. This role combines partner relationship management with academic operations and deadline-driven execution.

Most work is done from our office (hybrid), supporting schools remotely through monitoring, coordination, reporting, and problem-solving. However, this is a travel-heavy role during key academic periods (onboarding, start-of-term implementation, trainings, quality checks, strategic visits). During these periods, expect demanding schedules with frequent trips and full-day on-site work.

This role requires full ownership: consistent follow-through, early risk escalation, accurate record-keeping, and driving issues to resolution without reminders.

Critical Operations Coverage (important)

Occasionally, urgent academic or partner issues arise outside standard hours (including breaks). When this happens, you must be reachable, respond promptly, and help drive resolution, especially when student progress, compliance, or partner trust is at risk. This is occasional, not constant, but we take responsibility when something critical needs handling.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own assigned partner schools as primary contact; maintain strong relationships with coordinators, teachers, and stakeholders
  • Provide day-to-day partner support across channels (WhatsApp, email, calls) with fast follow-up and clear communication
  • Lead on-site visits during travel-intensive periods to align expectations, deliver trainings, run quality checks, and drive action plans (including occasional weekends)
  • Ensure consistent implementation of WorldEd curriculum, methodology, resources, and instructional technology
  • Monitor student progress and operations (completion, grades, deadlines); proactively flag risks and coordinate interventions
  • Troubleshoot academic and technology issues; escalate when needed and own resolution through closure
  • Enforce WorldEd academic policies and quality standards (integrity, attendance, grading), including evidence reviews and corrective actions
  • Maintain auditable documentation in LMS/SIS and shared trackers; provide regular reporting to partners and leadership with risks, actions, owners, and due dates

Success Metrics (LAER-aligned)

Measured by: Retention, Adoption, Completion, SLA/Responsiveness, and NPS/Satisfaction across your assigned partner schools.

Qualifications

Required

  • 4+ years in academic coordination/operations, program management, customer success, or partner success (international or multi-school partnerships strongly preferred)
  • Strong operational execution: accurate tracking, consistent follow-up, reliable delivery against timelines
  • Strong stakeholder management: ability to run trainings, handle sensitive conversations, coordinate across multiple decision-makers
  • Systems and data-oriented: proficient with LMS/online platforms and dashboards/trackers; quick to learn new tools
  • Fluent English required
  • Full availability to travel, including demanding schedules during specific periods, with on-site full days and occasional weekends

This role is not for you if… (important)

  • … you’re not fully available to travel or you want a role that is primarily office-only.
  • … you avoid follow-up and don’t like operating with deadlines, checklists, and accountability.
  • … you prefer “handing off” problems instead of owning them through to resolution.
  • … you expect rigid boundaries regardless of context and won’t step in when something critical needs to be handled.

What We Offer

  • A culture in a constantly growing segment with continuous learning opportunities.
  • Full scholarship for direct dependents in WorldEd’s Programs.
  • Total Pass wellness and quality of life benefit.
  • Hybrid work model: Sao Paulo (Zona Sul) office + home-office + regular partner visits nationwide.
  • Parking at headquarters.
  • Compensation plan, consisting of a fixed monthly amount + bonus plan tied to goals.

If you’re passionate about helping students succeed through high-quality education, disciplined about operational execution, strong in partner relationship management, and fully available to travel as needed to drive partner success on-site, we want to hear from you.

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.

Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.

The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.

The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.

Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.

Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.

Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.

No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.

About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: GERENTE DE MINA SUBTERRÂNEA
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos a ERO , uma mineradora que nasceu no coração do Brasil e cresceu levando para o mundo mais força e energia — uma força que impulsiona setores produtivos e contribui para o desenvolvimento de diferentes regiões.

Desde 1979, quando iniciou suas atividades na unidade Caraíba, a empresa vem consolidando sua presença no setor mineral brasileiro, expandindo para a mina de ouro em Xavantina, avançando na implantação da unidade Tucumã — que promete se tornar um dos principais polos de produção de cobre do país. Nosso crescimento é movido pela experiência em exploração, que nos ajuda a expandir a vida útil de nossas minas e a avançar em novos projetos, como o Projeto Furnas, no Pará.

Nosso jeito de fazer mineração é guiado por valores sólidos: cuidado, coragem, honestidade, colaboração e excelência. Esses princípios estão no centro de tudo o que fazemos — desde o chão da mina até as decisões estratégicas. E eles também orientam como cuidamos do crescimento de cada pessoa na Ero.

O nosso objetivo é claro: ser a melhor empresa de mineração do Brasil, e sabemos que isso só é possível investindo nas pessoas que constroem esse futuro com a gente, todos os dias.

Se identificou?

Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como GERENTE DE MINA que será responsável por liderar a operação da mina subterrânea garantindo Segurança como valor , cumprimento do plano de produção e desenvolvimento , estabilidade geotécnica, qualidade do minério entregue à planta, eficiência de equipamentos/pessoas, e aderência a padrões legais, ambientais e de governança.

Modelo de contratação: Efetivo, CLT | Presencial

Gerência: Gerência Sênior de Operação de Mina - Pilar

✨ Venha crescer com a gente!

#SomosEro #TrabalheConosco #Oportunidade

A Ero não cobra nenhum valor para a participação em suas etapas de recrutamento e seleção. Todas as candidaturas devem ser realizadas exclusivamente por meio dos nossos canais oficiais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Papeis e responsabilidades:

  • Entregar o plano de produção (t/mes, t/dia, teor, diluição, recuperação, blend) conforme orçamento e plano de mina.
  • Gestão de turnos e frentes : dimensionamento de equipes, despacho, priorização de áreas, produtividade por ciclo (perfuração–carregamento–detonação–ventilação–mucking–transporte).
  • Controle de perfuração e desmonte : padrões de malha, qualidade do carregamento de explosivos, vibração/overbreak, cumprimento de janelas operacionais e reentrada segura.
  • Gestão de carregamento e transporte (LHD/LP, caminhões, correias/shaft quando aplicável): disponibilidade, utilização, tempos de ciclo, filas e gargalos.
  • Controle de qualidade do ROM : interface com Geologia/Planejamento para controle de teor, reconciliação curto prazo, redução de diluição e perdas.
  • Padronização e disciplina operacional : procedimentos, rotinas de turno, checklists e auditorias de campo (Gemba), aderência a padrões.
  • Gestão de contratadas (quando aplicável): metas, medições, produtividade, segurança, escopo e qualidade.
  • Entregar o plano de desenvolvimento (mês/semana/dia): avanço em metros, qualidade do perfil, compliance com seção/projeto, execução de nichos, câmaras, raise/ore pass/vent raise conforme escopo.
  • Gestão de ciclo de desenvolvimento : perfuração, desmonte, carregamento, saneamento, escalamento, limpeza e suporte com foco em taxa de avanço e estabilidade.
  • Ventilação e infraestrutura : garantir ventilação adequada por distrito (quantidade/qualidade do ar), controle de poeira/gases, energia, água, drenagem e comunicações.
  • Sustentação e controle de terreno (ground control) : execução do padrão de suporte (chumbadores, tela, shotcrete, cabos), inspeções de segurança e gestão de riscos geotécnicos em conjunto com Geotecnia.
  • Gestão de backfill (se aplicável): planejamento de janelas, logística, qualidade do fill, interface com operação para sequenciamento seguro/otimizado.
  • Interface com projetos e engenharia : comissionamento de novas áreas, ramp-ups, obras subterrâneas e melhorias de layout/fluxo

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Engenheiro de minas;
  • Necessário conhecimento em aplicação de concreto projetado;
  • Extensivo conhecimento das operações de mina subterrânea;
  • Experiência solida com gestão de equipes;
  • Inglês avançado para conversação;
  • Experiência com gestão de contratos (desenvolvimento, perfuração e desmonte, saneamento/escoramento/shotcrete, raiseboring, pastefill, infraestrutura subterrânea, manutenção terceirizada), com histórico de ganhos em produtividade e custo);
  • Vivência com gestão orçamentária OPEX e CAPEX, com elaboração de orçamento anual, forecast, controle de desvios e priorização de investimentos via business cases;

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Business Development Representative (BDR)

About Us

XDRhub is a specialized sales and business development outsourcing company. We are professional cold-callers dedicated to helping small and mid-sized businesses grow through tailored outbound strategies. Our mission is simple: empower our clients to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace by building their pipelines with high-quality opportunities.

About the Role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) , you will represent one of our clients and act as the first point of contact for prospective buyers. Your primary responsibility is to proactively identify, engage, and qualify decision-makers (Directors, VPs, and C-level executives).

This role is highly outbound-driven: you will spend your time cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting via LinkedIn, and using modern sales tools to generate meetings. You’ll run early-stage discovery conversations and hand off qualified opportunities to the sales team.

You’ll be working in a fast-paced environment where communication, persistence, and organization are key.

About You

We are looking for a driven, articulate communicator who thrives in outbound sales.

  • English Proficiency – Excellent oral and written English (C1 level or higher). Native-like fluency is required, as you will be speaking directly with US-based executives.
  • Sales Mindset – Fearless hunter mentality with a proven ability to prospect, cold call, and build pipeline.
  • Experience with Sales Solutions(Preferred) – Prior experience engaging Sales and Revenue executives is a strong plus.
  • Curious & Coachable – Eager to learn and grow; open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training.
  • Self-Starter – Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members.
  • Tech-Savvy – Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment .

Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation

  • Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts.
  • Cold call and email sales executives (VP of Sales, Head of Sales, Chief Revenue Officer, CEO) to secure meetings and demos.

Team Coordination

  • Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs.
  • Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team’s success.

Data Management

  • Maintain accurate records of outreach, leads, conversations, and pipeline progress in both our CRM and client CRMs.
  • Track activity, outcomes, and ensure reporting is up to date.

Metrics & KPIs

  • Number of dials per day (100+ average) and meeting conversion rate.
  • Number of meaningful conversations and meetings booked.
  • Email outreach volume and reply rate.
  • Meeting attendance rate.

Schedule

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week.
  • Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET.
  • Open to applicants based in LATAM.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission (60/40 split).
  • SPIFFs and performance incentives.
  • Training, mentoring, and growth opportunities to become a top-performing sales professional.

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS) - HOME OFFICE
description:

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.

Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.

Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

title: Finance Business Partner
description:
1. Budgeting & Forecasting:

Develop annual budgets and rolling forecasts, monitor variances, and recommend adjustments to align financial goals with business strategies. Optimize resource allocation and decompose targets to support performance achievement.

2. Business Analysis & Reporting:

Establish a business KPI framework, generate regular analytical reports, identify anomalies, and conduct root cause analysis. Propose actionable strategies to drive operational improvements and cost-efficiency.

3. Decision Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Engage with frontline operations to assess projects and design solutions. Provide financial insights for decision-making, resolve cross-departmental bottlenecks, and ensure strategic execution.

4. Risk Management & Compliance:

Identify risks (e.g., revenue inflation, delivery fraud) and implement preventive controls. Monitor cash flow, receivables, and payables to mitigate bad debt and liquidity risks.

5. Data Systems & Tool Development:

Design data models and automation tools (e.g., BI dashboards) to streamline financial processes. Enhance data accuracy and analytical efficiency for precision in business operations.

6. Special Projects & Capability Building:

Lead initiatives like industry research and competitor analysis, standardizing methodologies. Conduct financial training to elevate team expertise and foster sustained business-finance integration.
